# Service Prompt Skeleton

This directory is reserved for service-level prompts used by an external Agent runner.

Do not move or rewrite the canonical PPT Master prompts in `skills/ppt-master/SKILL.md`, `skills/ppt-master/references/`, or `skills/ppt-master/workflows/`.

Planned prompt files:

- `strategist_system.md`
- `executor_system.md`
- `image_planner.md`
- `template_fill_planner.md`
- `revision.md`
- `quality_repair.md`
